categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the production and sales of polystyrene resins including general-purpose polystyrene (GPS), expandable polystyrene (EPS), acrylonitrile-butadiene-styrene (ABS) copolymers, styrene-acrylonitrile (SAN) copolymers, plastic raw materials and processed products, glass wool products, and curved surface printing products. It also engages in noise and vibration control engineering and interior decoration services. The EPS segment accounts for about 50.45% of revenue, ABS 25.07%, GPS 21.52%, and glass wool 2.94%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes polymerization technologies for ABS, SAN, GPS, and EPS production, including specialized processes such as NOVA for GPS and pilot plant setups for butadiene emulsion polymerization. It emphasizes quality optimization, such as phenol-free ABS and improved EPS formulations enhancing surface hardness and molding efficiency. The company also holds ISO certifications for recycled content and environmental management, and employs advanced manufacturing controls to improve product performance and sustainability.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include downstream processors in electronics, household appliances, automotive parts, packaging, construction insulation, and consumer goods sectors. The company serves mainly export markets, with over 85% of sales outside Taiwan, focusing on Southeast Asia, South Asia, Africa, Central and South America, and North America. The glass wool products primarily serve domestic markets and Australia/New Zealand. The company targets emerging markets beyond China and Hong Kong to diversify sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales cover Taiwan, China (notably Guangdong, Yunnan, Hubei, Fujian, Sichuan, Chongqing), Southeast Asia, South Asia, Africa, Central and South America, North America, Australia, and New Zealand. The company has production facilities in Taiwan and China, including Lin Yuan, Qianzhen, Zhongshan, and Toufen plants, with sales expanding in emerging markets outside Greater China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily midstream in the petrochemical supply chain, producing polymer resins from upstream raw materials such as styrene monomer (SM), acrylonitrile (AN), and butadiene (BD). It sources these raw materials from domestic and international suppliers and supplies polymer resins and related products to downstream processors and manufacturers in various industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include maximizing production and sales volumes, optimizing customer mix, expanding markets beyond China and Hong Kong, and enhancing product quality and application development. R&D focuses on ABS quality optimization, phenol-free formulations, pilot plant development for butadiene emulsion polymerization, EPS formulation improvements for hardness and efficiency, and development of environmentally friendly products with recycled content certifications. The company also emphasizes ESG initiatives, energy efficiency, and sustainable product development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of polymer resins (EPS, ABS, GPS, SAN), glass wool insulation products, and related plastic materials. The company also earns income from foreign exchange gains, rental income, interest, and dividends. Sales are largely export-driven, with a focus on volume and market diversification to maintain full production and sales balance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other major producers of ABS, GPS, and EPS in Taiwan and China, where capacity expansions have intensified competition. It holds a competitive position by leveraging product quality, proprietary manufacturing processes (e.g., NOVA for GPS), and broad geographic market coverage. The company faces challenges from overcapacity in China and global economic uncertainties but maintains market share through customer service, product differentiation, and strategic market development.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated net sales of approximately NT$18.6 billion in the latest fiscal year, representing a 22% increase from the prior year. Despite increased sales, it recorded a net loss of about NT$223 million, an improvement from the previous year's loss. Total assets were around NT$9.8 billion with equity of NT$6.3 billion. The company is investing in capital expenditures focused on environmental and energy efficiency improvements and maintains a stable workforce of approximately 480 employees.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality polymer products with enhanced performance characteristics such as phenol-free ABS and improved EPS hardness and molding efficiency. It differentiates through proprietary manufacturing technologies, environmental certifications (ISO 14021 for recycled content), and sustainable product development aligned with ESG principles. The company also offers customized technical support and maintains a diversified global customer base to reduce market risk and enhance value.
